text: I have been ordered to write it. There are people, unaccountable as it may appear, who actually take more interest in what my niece’s maid said to me on this occasion than in what I said to my niece’s maid. Amusing perversity! “I should feel very much obliged to you, sir, if you would kindly tell me what I had better do,” remarked the Young Person. “Let things stop as they are,” I said, adapting my language to my listener.
